------Applicant  VERSUS   State Of Chhattisgarh Through The Station House Officer, P.S.
 Balrampur, District - Balrampur-Ramanujganj, Chhattisgarh.
For Applicant : Mr. T.R. Patel, Advocate
For Non-applicant-State : Mr. Jitendra Shrivastava, G.A.
SB: Hon'ble Shri Parth Prateem Sahu, Judge

This is the first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail, as he has been arrested in connection with Crime No. 53/2023 registered at Police Station - Balrampur, District - Balrampur-Ramanujganj, Chhattisgarh for the offences punishable under Sections 376 (3) and 376 (2) (n) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Section 4 & 6 of the Prevention of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act, 2012.
2. Pursuant to the notice issued by this Court, victim appeared before this Court through virtual mode from D.LS.A. Balrampur, District - Balrampur-Ramanujganj and raised strong objection in grant of bail to the applicant.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that he may be permitted to withdraw this application at this stage.
He, however, submits that the applicant is in jail since 13.05.2023.
Therefore, learned Trial Court be directed to expedite the trial.
4. In view of the submissions made by the learned Counsel for the applicant, this application is dimisssed as withdrawn.
However, learned Trial Court is directed to expedite the trial.
